findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_reading_days, summarize_reading_period, list_quotes_due_for_review, add_book_to_library, add_matched_books_to_library, update_book_status, save_poem_line · Private data: lookup_books_batch, get_reading_days, get_reading_stats, summarize_reading_period, record_quote_review, add_book_to_library, add_matched_books_to_library, update_book_status, delete_reading_insight, log_poem_read, annotate_poem_line · Public sink: get_daily_reading_connections, log_reading_session · Destructive: get_reading_notes, delete_reading_insight, save_reading_insight.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_reading_days, summarize_reading_period, list_quotes_due_for_review, add_book_to_library, add_matched_books_to_library, update_book_status, save_poem_line · Private data: lookup_books_batch, get_reading_days, get_reading_stats, summarize_reading_period, record_quote_review, add_book_to_library, add_matched_books_to_library, update_book_status, delete_reading_insight, log_poem_read, annotate_poem_line · Public sink: get_daily_reading_connections, log_reading_session · Destructive: get_reading_notes, delete_reading_insight, save_reading_insight

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_daily_reading_connections" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Returns today's connections in the reader's reading: passages from different books they are reading, and from their saved quotes and notes, that share a theme, with the theme named and a question to reflect on. The text of a passage from a book is returned only when the reader uploaded their own cop"

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
